facts.fact: e-GA reports that since GovESB began, more than 180 public institutions are connected and more than 200 systems communicate and exchange data through it.
e-GA reports that more than 180 public institutions are connected to GovESB and more than 200 systems exchange data through it.

TZA.note: No exchange or transaction volume stated.
GovESB is a data exchange bus, not a citizen portal or app; no online services counted.

facts.fact: Prime Minister Majaliwa praised e-GA's use of local experts to build government ICT systems and awarded 15 e-GA ICT officers who took part in building GovESB, on 23 June 2025.
e-GA is reported as having built GovESB, which more than 180 public institutions have joined to exchange data across government.

TZA.note: Go-live date of GovESB not stated, so no built-and-live fact.
